scope: Integrated local resilience scenario over the existing offline spool, collector delivery, signed configuration and C05 storage: signed-bounded offline retention with durable gap/loss accounting, duplicate batch replay idempotency, real store restart convergence, delivery continuing across the explicit gap, typed negative batches, and a no-network import boundary over the composed path. Existing C13 container egress and C14/C16 SIGKILL anchors run in the same required suite.
source_identity_algorithm: sorted path + NUL + raw SHA-256 over tracked/nonignored source, excluding docs/evidence/, SHA256SUMS.txt, plans/progress.json and docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json

composition.offline_bound: spool.Store.Enqueue with sensor.AcceptBoundedWithOverflow and the C11 applied signed spool_limit_events=3
composition.duplicate_batches: collector.Ingestor.Ingest with exact C04 bytes, C07 identity and append-only C05 spool.ack records
composition.restart: storage.Store closed and reopened at the same path; sensor.NewApplier re-projects the applied revision; spool/collector recreated
composition.egress: source-level import boundary for internal/spool, internal/collector and internal/sensor; the real rootless-container anchor TestDecoyIsolationDeniesInternetAndPrivateSubnets ran in the same suite
composition.crash: existing C14/C16 SIGKILL and syscall anchors ran in the same suite; C26 adds no crash harness

results: Bounded spool: events 1-3 retained, event 4 dropped with typed spool.DroppedError, one durable gap [4,4], exact retry unchanged.
Duplicate batch: identical event and acknowledgement receipts; event/acknowledgement counts unchanged before and after restart.
Collector restart: applied revision 1 and payload, receipts, acknowledgements and loss summary survived close/reopen; [3] then [5,6] delivered across the explicit gap.
Final durable state: 1 config, 5 events, 5 acknowledgements, 1 gap; no loss marker was rewritten or removed.

Negative cases: unconfigured sensor, empty batch, batch over the applied limit, sensor mismatch, declared-span mismatch, malformed event and conflicting replay returned their typed sentinels with unchanged manifest bytes and record counts.

Egress: the composed path imports no net/net-*, os/exec, syscall, plugin or C package; TestDecoyIsolationDeniesInternetAndPrivateSubnets passed against the pinned rootless provider and image in the same suite.
observed_limitations: Local Linux ext4/tmpfs process and filesystem proofs only; no physical power-loss, multi-host or consensus claim.
Existing C13/C14/C16 anchors provide the container egress and SIGKILL crash evidence; C26 does not duplicate or strengthen them.
spool_limit_events=3 and event_batch_limit=2 are fixture policy, not product defaults or measured capacity.
The browser suite was not run because C26 changes no web source; it remains covered by the unchanged web workflow.
